And major shout-out to Patrick Staffan's brother for being so open and beginning his powerful journey of transformation.

Scattered around Scotland are endless abandoned castles. We venture into the unknown to explore them and their mysterious past alongside a legendary group.

Who are we? 
We believe life’s greatest moments and deepest connections exist outside your comfort zone.
